text:
maria: Quick sync — kicking off a surgical entitlement curation. Goal: 2-week canary to remove ownerless admin bindings and tighten KMS grants for infra projects. I sketched a plan below. Feedback?

sam: love it. can we scope to 3 clusters + infra-prod KMS first, then expand? keeps blast radius small. :thumbsup:

lena: +1 to small scope. also want a pre-change smoke test for CI deploys and cross-account service accounts.

kevin: nit: we should record a snapshot before any removals. I can push an audit dump to S3.

maria: yes — snapshot is item 0. proposed signals: auth failures, deploy-job failures, and svc account ownerless alerts.

anya: do we have a reliable query for ownerless KMS grants? I had flaky results last time when roles were inherited.

maria: good question. sketch of queries i used (pulled from infra-audit):
```sql
-- ownerless admin-like bindings
SELECT principal, role, resource
FROM iam_bindings
WHERE owner IS NULL AND LOWER(role) LIKE '%admin%';
```
And a quick kms check:
```bash
gcloud kms keys list --project infra-prod --location global \ 
  --format="table(name,primaryCryptoKeyVersion.algorithm,labels)"
```
This won't catch inherited roles; we'll need to join with org policies.

kevin: i can add the inheritance join tomorrow. also recommend tagging each candidate binding with: detected_ts, remediation_plan_id, rollback_handle.

security-bot: Automated scan: 14 ownerless admin-like bindings found across projects infra-prod, staging-2, data-analytics. Risk: high for infra-prod.

maria: ok — priority = infra-prod (7 bindings), then staging-2 (4), then analytics (3). Plan:
- Week 0: snapshot + canary list + ps docs + notify owners + schedule maintenance window
- Week 1: run canary removals (one binding per day) with 4h monitoring window
- Week 2: expand / cleanup remaining bindings

sam: runbook note: if deploy failures observed, auto-readd binding and open incident ticket. prefer manual rollback first.

lena: monitoring hooks I want in place:
- deploy pipeline broken jobs -> slack #release-alerts
- 401/403 spike on auth proxy -> alert to eng-sre
- kms decryption errors -> ops-oncall ping

maria: here's a tentative canary candidate list (IDs obfuscated):
- projects/infra-prod/roles/admin-ops (binding id: b-23a)
- projects/infra-prod/serviceAccounts/svc-ci@infra-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com 
- projects/staging-2/roles/db-admin (binding id: s-9f)

anya: for svc accounts we should check token usage windows. if last-used > 90d -> safe to remove.

kevin: agreed. i'll add last_used and recent_token_activity to the audit dump.

maria: can someone volunteer to run the initial canary on monday? I'm on call for security triage that day so can coordinate.

sam: I can run day-1 canary and monitor deploys.

lena: i'll watch pipeline alerts and do quick manual smoke test on canary apps.

ops-oncall: ops-oncall standing by for kms decryption alerts. ping me with the maintenance window.

maria: outstanding action items:
1) kevin -> full audit dump + inheritance enrichment (due EOD today)
2) sam -> prep rollback playbook and canary run script (due Mon morning)
3) lena -> add monitoring alerts and dashboard (due Mon morning)
4) anya -> prepare svcacct last-used report (due Mon morning)
5) maria -> owners notification + maintenance window calendar (today)

kevin: starting dump now. example output format I'll push:
```json
["principal","role","resource","owner","last_used","binding_id","detected_ts"]
```
I'll upload to s3://redwood-security-audit/5342109876/

security-bot: FYI: previous removal runbook at https://redwood.internal/runbooks/entitlement-prune has rollback snippets and a canary checklist.

maria: perfect. let's use that as base and update with KMS-specific checks.

sam: quick question — if a binding is reintroduced by infra-automation, do we want a short-lived exception flow or force PR + approval?

lena: prefer PR + approver to avoid config drift. short-lived exceptions via manual approved ticket only.

maria: agreed. exception queue: issue in internal JIRA with label `entitlement-exception` and auto-cc security-sre.

anya: one more: canary removals should include a config snapshot diff so we can see exactly what changed in the binding table.

kevin: will include diffs in the s3 upload and tag artifacts with `canary-5342109876`

maria: thanks everyone. i'll send out the notify email and calendar invite. we'll reconvene in this thread after the first canary run. :rotating_light: 

ops-oncall: noted. ping me 30m before the first removal.

sam: thanks — will post live logs here during the run.

maria: closing for now, re-open as we get canary telemetry. :eyes:
